title: Owner Self-Use Blocker Matrix (PASS 44)
note: A BLOCKER prevents safe owner self-use entirely. A RESTRICTION is a documented limitation the owner works within.

restrictions.restriction: Structured field-by-field issue entry (/api/owner/manual-entry) has no dedicated UI; the owner enters data via the Data Intake page (manual form / CSV / paste) + per-domain snapshot forms + '+ New business'.
restrictions.workaround: Use /owner/intake and the domain snapshot forms.

restrictions.restriction: No Dockerfile/vercel.json and no runtime env-schema; deploy is developer-assisted and needs NODE_ENV + DATABASE_URL + NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL + AUTH_SECRET.
restrictions.workaround: A developer deploys with the documented env vars; owner does not self-deploy.

restrictions.restriction: One workspace per signup; no in-app switcher.
restrictions.workaround: One owner business context per login.

restrictions.restriction: The cockpit page is desktop-tuned (fixed padding); onboarding/intake are responsive.
No in-app support/debug surface and no one-click undo; governed records aren't destructively deleted and reassessment re-opens decisions.
restrictions.workaround: Owner requests reassessment or asks a developer.

restrictions.restriction: The post-login /dashboard does not surface the owner section; the owner opens /owner (the Owner hub), whose sidebar exposes the 'Owner Cockpit' link.
restrictions.workaround: Navigate to /owner after login, then click Owner Cockpit.

conclusion: No BLOCKER. 5 documented RESTRICTIONS. Overall: OWNER_SELF_USE_READY_WITH_RESTRICTIONS.
